oracle_text:

name: Investigator's Journal
oracle_text:
This artifact enters with a number of suspect counters on it equal to the greatest number of creatures a player controls.
{2}, {T}, Remove a suspect counter from this artifact: Draw a card.
{2}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

name: Solemnity
oracle_text:
Players can't get counters.
Counters can't be put on artifacts, creatures, enchantments, or lands.

name: Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider
oracle_text:
Trample, haste
If you would put one or more counters on a permanent or player, put twice that many of each of those kinds of counters on that permanent or player instead.
If an opponent would put one or more counters on a permanent or player, they put half that many of each of those kinds of counters on that permanent or player instead, rounded down.

name: Open the Vaults
oracle_text: Return all artifact and enchantment cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under their owners' control. (Auras with nothing to enchant remain in graveyards.)
